page: Amazon Web Services c9gd.24xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by AWS Graviton ARM64 processors. It features 96 dedicated physical cores operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz, with a single thread per core configuration. This architecture provides dedicated compute resources without the resource-sharing overhead of simultaneous multithreading.

The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. For local storage, it includes 5700 GB of NVMe SSD instance store volumes, providing high-speed, low-latency local storage directly attached to the Nitro hypervisor.

Network performance is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 50 Gbps. The combination of high-core-count ARM64 processing, a 1:2 memory-to-CPU ratio, and substantial local NVMe storage makes this instance suitable for compute-intensive workloads that also require high-speed local scratch space, such as distributed databases, video encoding, data analytics, and batch processing.
